rationale: The breakdown at the $25.73 session low failed to follow through, and price has since reclaimed the 5-minute 9-EMA ($25.97) with five consecutive higher lows on the 1-minute chart. The core technical premise of the short entry (rejection below the 9-EMA) is broken, making it prudent to exit immediately at $26.09 rather than waiting for the $26.15 stop to trigger and further erode the tight remaining daily loss budget. Flipping to long is avoided due to the stock's severe intraday relative weakness and declining bounce volume.
